permission.keepAwakeDesc: Keep the device awake while the screen is locked, so remote control and background agent tasks keep running
permission.autoLaunchDesc: Tianshu will start automatically after you log in to your computer
permission.autoInstallTrustedSkillsDesc: Install automatically once security checks pass; high-risk items always require manual confirmation
permission.autoUpdateSkillsDesc: Automatically update installed skills to the latest version; skills you have edited in Tianshu are never updated

storage.cacheDirectoryDesc: Stores chat history, runtime cache, and temporary files
storage.workspacePathDesc: New tasks and workspaces are stored under this path; existing data is not affected

notification.desktopDesc: Get system alerts when tasks finish or new messages arrive
notification.testBody: Desktop notifications are on. You will be alerted here when tasks finish or new messages arrive.
notification.clientDesc: Operational messages are shown in-app first, and switch to desktop notifications once the app goes to the background
